text: In this ESN implementation, only the readout weights W_out are trained (via ridge regression); the reservoir weights W_rec and W_in stay fixed as random matrices.
explanation: True: esn.py builds W_rec and W_in randomly (rescaled to ρ and σ_in) and never updates them; only fit() solves for W_out via ridge regression. Training just the readout is the defining feature of reservoir computing.
